description: Workspace observability item that routes Fabric workspace diagnostics to an Eventhouse and Eventstream and can enable an Operations Agent.

definition_parts.description: Data collection source/destination mapping and optional Operations Agent state.
Optional Git-integration metadata. Use update-definition --update-metadata to apply it.

flags.--name: Required display name: 2-128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores, periods, or hyphens; no spaces or leading/trailing double underscore.
flags.--folder-id: Optional folder; omitted means the workspace root.
flags.--file/--content: Optional full definition JSON or raw MonitoringProperties.json.

notes: Only one Monitoring item per workspace can have data collection enabled; enabling another returns WSMDataCollectionAlreadyEnabledInWorkspace.
Enable/disable are idempotent and do not alter the definition.
dataCollectionSettings, when present, must contain exactly one complete source/destination mapping.
Eventhouse mode and a linked parent Monitoring reference cannot be changed or removed after configuration.
operationsAgent requires dataCollectionSettings and an explicit enabled value. Once enabled, it cannot be disabled or removed.
Get-definition requires usage rights to remove an encrypted sensitivity label.
Validate offline before pushing: fabio item validate-definition --type Monitoring --dir <folder>.
